title: Megurine Luka — Starting Point〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're back.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome back.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How was the station?
Did you notice any changes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we didn't notice anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even the sprout we found looked exactly the same.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I was so sure that more big changes would come after that station appeared.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I sort of understand how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that station appearing is a pretty big event itself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Imagine what would happen to this place if more stuff like that kept happening.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're no fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I'm perplexed by how a station of all things ended up appearing here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Lots of students take the train to school every day, so it doesn't seem all that strange to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I agree. I mean, I wish Miya Girls and Shibuya Station were as close as this school and station are.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But wouldn't that be too close?
I feel like you'd have fewer fun detours to take along the way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's a good point...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I don't think that train's meant for commuting to school.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems like it's meant for leaving this school for somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Leaving this school for somewhere else...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But where?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But schools are places you're supposed to graduate from, right? In that sense, this is a sort of starting line for you girls.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
G-Graduate?!
Are you saying that Sakki and the others are gonna stop coming here someday?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
No one's told us anything about that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't wanna stop coming here! I wanna keep hanging out with you and the others, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna keep jamming and hanging out with all of you too, Sakki!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why are you equating graduating to saying goodbye?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Rin.
We're here in SEKAI to give them the support they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We won't be saying goodbye anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sh-She's right, Rin...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They just became pros, so we need to keep watching over them as their careers unfold!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, you and Rin really made my stomach sink with that stuff, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If the girls do end up graduating, would that mean we'd also graduate...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, we might stop being students here?
But I really like my uniform.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's what you're attached to...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we wouldn't have to say goodbye to Sakki and them, but we would have to say goodbye to this school?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Again, quit blowing things out of proportion.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, all good things must come to an end...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, we can't fully eliminate the possibility of us having to say goodbye to this place someday...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But we can say for certain that this place isn't going away.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it was born out of you girls' feelings. It has a special place in your hearts and it's your starting point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, it's important to look back to the beginning from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, even if all of you do end up going somewhere far away, I'm sure you'll be able to come back here whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's why this SEKAI exists. This refuge is a manifestation of your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And now that we're pros, we need to learn to treasure this place even more.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Girls...
